notes.1280: 1280 boreguot: 'especially good'; with the negative, 'none too good'. 1287 vageten is uncertain; read as 'were pleasing to'. 1289: 'these' may be the herbs (so here) or the people themselves.
notes.4667: 4671 liezen: to cast lots, to divine.

nodes.text: Then there was no one else.
Then he bade angels come into being.
with angels he fully furnished them.
Truly, I will tell you this.
His penance was none too good;
evil were his heart and his mind.
they were pleasing to the devil.
so that these would not harm their offspring.
some had the mouth on the breast,
they had to go without a head.
that they covered themselves with them.
with which he afterwards brought him to grief.
cut the bark off them here and there,
in places let white show through;
some he did not peel at all.
He carried them with him in the evening;
he leaned them in the trough.
and the ram leapt on her —
as she looked at the speckled rod,
How could you act so badly
as to repay my lord in this way,
from which he was accustomed to drink
and in which he used to cast lots?
it shall go hard with you.”
